preconditions.description: The length n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The alphabet size p is between 1 and 26 inclusive.
The input string s has exactly length n.

preconditions.expression: all(ord(c) - ord('a') < p for c in s)
preconditions.description: Every character in s is one of the first p lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(s[i:i+2] != s[i:i+2][::-1] and s[i:i+3] != s[i:i+3][::-1] for i in range(len(s)-1))
preconditions.description: The input string s contains no palindromic substring of length 2 or more (guaranteed tolerable).

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (len(stdout.strip()) == n and stdout.strip() > s and is_tolerable(stdout.strip(), p) and is_next_tolerable(stdout.strip(), s, p, n))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' if no solution exists, or the lexicographically smallest tolerable string of length n that is strictly greater than s.
